name: Infantry_RemoteRunner
author: Infantry AI
description: Remote runners: the runner link's transport (wss with a pinned self-signed certificate, the runner's listener and the orchestrator's client). Core keeps pairing, credentials, rekey, detach, audit and the allow-lists; this plugin carries the frames and binds paired runners to the runner pool (runnerBinding remote), so a ticket pinned to a runner starts there. A runner older than the app reads `outdated` and takes no start; `runner_update` (RUNNER-UPDATE-1, the Runners card's Update runner) recreates its local Docker container on the image matching the app (same name, volume, ports, restart policy and env; rollback on failure), or gives the one-line command to run on another machine. Off = this machine serves no runner link and `infantry runner add/pair/rotate/detach` say so. Daemon half only.

actions.label: Update a runner that is older than the app

fields.label: Runner image
fields.placeholder: empty = the image matching this app
fields.description: Empty = the local tag local-<this app's commit> of the repository the runner runs from, then the app's version tag, then the runner's own tag pulled again. Set it to recreate on one exact image.

fields.label: Registry image
fields.description: The repository the one-line update command names for a runner on another machine.

fields.label: Wait for the runner (s)
fields.description: How long the new container has to answer the link before the update is rolled back.

fields.label: Docker call timeout (s)
fields.description: The longest one docker call (a pull included) may take.
